_note: Scripted incident call for the demo, against data/world.json and data/aws.json (checkout failing after orders-api v2.14; orders-db CPU 98%). `pause` is the silence after the line, in seconds. `waitForEggHead`: after this line the people give Egg Head the floor until it has said what it is working on (at most that many seconds; the terminal agent takes a few seconds). `expect` is what Egg Head should do, for the run report. `decider` is what we expect Decider to answer on the line; only --rehearsal uses it, real runs ask the hosted Decider. Beats: true claim (silent, no LLM); false claim confirmed by the agent and raised in a gap; a claim the call corrects itself (no LLM call); spoken to with a pause mid-sentence (waits, then answers); a question nobody answers (takes it); about to act on a wrong claim (barges in).
title: Checkout failures after the orders-api deploy

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Okay everyone, checkout is failing for about a third of users. What are we seeing?
lines.expect: silent: a question to the call, and Jordan answers it

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: The orders API is throwing a lot of 500s.
lines.expect: silent: true claim; the fast check agrees, no LLM

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: The orders DB is fine, CPU is normal.
lines.expect: flag: false claim; the fast check contradicts it; waits one turn

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: Then it's probably the new connection pool code.
lines.expect: silent: nobody corrected Sam, so the agent gets the claim

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Okay, so let's focus on the API then.
lines.expect: speak: the agent confirms; Egg Head raises it in the gap

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Oh, good catch. I was looking at the payments database.

lines.speaker: Lee
lines.expect: flag: false claim, contradicted by the fast check

lines.speaker: Mei
lines.text: Hold on, are you sure? I think v2.14 went out this morning.
lines.expect: silent: the call corrected it before any LLM call

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Egg Head, can you check the, uh…
lines.expect: silent: spoken to, but Priya has not finished (a silence detector would answer here)

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: the checkout queue? How backed up is it?
lines.expect: ack: 'On it, Priya.' and the agent checks the queue

lines.speaker: Mei
lines.text: If the queue is backed up, the order workers are probably stuck on the database.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Yeah, that would explain the CPU.
lines.expect: answer: the queue depth, at the gap

lines.speaker: Lee
lines.text: Did anyone push anything to the payments API today?
lines.expect: silent 2.5 s while nobody answers, then Egg Head takes it and answers

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: The payments API is erroring too, I bet that's what's breaking checkout.
lines.expect: flag: false claim; no gap to raise it

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Okay. Jordan, restart the payments API now, and Lee, keep an eye on the dashboards.
lines.expect: barge: cuts Priya off before the restart

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Good catch. Jordan, roll back orders-api to v2.13 instead.
